# Variable `SYSROOT_DIRS_IGNORE`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Directories that are not staged into the sysroot by the do_populate_sysroot task. You can use this variable to exclude certain subdirectories of directories listed in SYSROOT_DIRS from staging. By default, the following directories are not staged:

```
SYSROOT_DIRS_IGNORE = " \
    ${mandir} \
    ${docdir} \
    ${infodir} \
    ${datadir}/X11/locale \
    ${datadir}/applications \
    ${datadir}/bash-completion \
    ${datadir}/fonts \
    ${datadir}/gtk-doc/html \
    ${datadir}/installed-tests \
    ${datadir}/locale \
    ${datadir}/pixmaps \
    ${datadir}/terminfo \
    ${libdir}/${BPN}/ptest \
    "

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SYSROOT_DIRS_IGNORE)
